_ticker: 6838 多摩川ホールディングス
title: Segment Bridge - Tamagawa HD (6838)
intro: Two reportable segments: Electronic & Communication Equipment (radio, measurement, information and industrial equipment; government and 5G/mobile infrastructure) and Renewable Energy (small wind / solar plant sales and power sales). All figures JPY mn; the source filings are in JPY thousands.

COMPARABILITY WARNING: the four columns are NOT a time series. FY2024/10 is a 7-month transition period (Apr-Oct 2024) under J-GAAP; FY2025/10 is 12 months under J-GAAP; the two H1 columns are 6 months under IFRS (transition date 2024-11-01). No growth rate is computed across these columns on purpose. Margins within a column are comparable; growth between columns is not.

Segment profit is operating-profit based. The adjustment row is disclosed group overhead (plus unrealised-profit eliminations), so the profit bridge closes to the disclosed consolidated operating profit.

Informational sheet: no cell on the DCF Model sheet references it. Tables 2-5 below reference 'Reverse DCF' and hold the Q3 replacement cells, the Addvalue EV bridge, the NWC decomposition and the normalisation bridge.

extra_tables.title: NWC - work-in-process build: activity (COGS scale) vs days, plus order intake vs sales (J-GAAP)
rows: Work in process  仕掛品
COGS run-rate (FY2024/10 = 7M x 12/7)
Annualising a 7-month period is an approximation (seasonality not removed) - 推定.
WIP days (balance / COGS x 365)
Days lengthened about 9%.
Check: (1+COGS growth) x (1+days growth) - 1
Must equal the WIP growth in row 1.
WIP increase explained by activity (COGS scale)
Price and volume are inseparable here: COGS growth carries both material-price inflation and unit volume.
WIP increase explained by longer days (build-up)
Ambiguous: for a build-to-order maker a longer WIP cycle can lead orders (mass-production ramp) or signal slippage (customer-supplied parts delayed one H1 FY26 project).
Orders vs sales FY2025/10 (consolidated)
Orders exceeded sales by 199 -> backlog build.
Orders vs sales H1 FY2026 (consolidated)
Book-to-bill 1.15. E&C segment: orders 3,881 vs sales 3,449.5 (prior-year H1 orders 2,460).
Contract liabilities  契約負債
Advances up 2.4x - supports the order-led reading.
Trade receivables incl. contract assets
Unwound in H1 FY26 (IFRS receivables 2,021.2 -> 1,537.8), releasing +489.9 of operating CF.
extra_tables.note: Verdict (両義判定): activity explains about three quarters of the WIP build and is order-backed (book-to-bill above 1, contract liabilities up). The days component is the part to watch; H1 FY26 inventories already fell 2,752.7 -> 2,573.5 (IFRS), so the build has started to convert.
